notes.title: Spectator 1 Update — Achievement Fix & SteamAPI Update
notes.notes:
A new patch for Spectator 1 is live!

🛠️ Fixed a complex issue with the "Nightmare" achievement — it should now unlock properly when the conditions are met. Huge thanks to everyone who reported the bug!

🔄 Updated SteamAPI — improving overall compatibility and stability within the Steam ecosystem.

Thanks for your continued support and feedback!
Keep sharing your thoughts and bug reports — together, we’re making the game better.

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards and 3.0 update!
notes.notes:
**Game Update Changelog - Version 3.0**

Hello, dear players! We're thrilled to share some exciting news and fantastic updates that will enhance your gaming experience. Version 3.0 brings a wealth of improvements and new features that will keep you engaged and entertained. Let's dive right in:

**Exciting News:**

1. **Trading Card** Collect, trade, and earn new exciting steam profile backgrounds, badges and smiles.

2. **Spectator on consoles** We're thrilled to announce that Spectator will be making its way to the game consoles! 

3.**Support for Steam Deck** Our game is now optimized to take full advantage of the cutting-edge hardware, ensuring a seamless and immersive experience on this innovative platform.

**Game Changes:**

1.**Engine Upgrade** We've harnessed the power of the latest and greatest technology by updating the game engine to the 2022 Long-Term Support version. This ensures smoother gameplay, smaller game size, and enhanced overall performance.

2. **Unified Platforms** Breaking down barriers, we've merged all platform versions into one harmonious experience. Whether you're on Linux, MacOS, Windows, or the Steam Deck, you'll enjoy the same thrilling gameplay and features, creating a seamless and inclusive environment for all.

3. **Languages Refreshed** Our translators have been hard at work! All 32 languages have been meticulously updated, ensuring an authentic and immersive experience for players around the globe.

4. **Elegant Fonts for All** We've resolved font issues in the Chinese and Korean versions, ensuring that every character and symbol is displayed with grace and clarity.

5. **Anomaly fixed** Good news, anomaly hunters! We've eradicated a pesky bug that caused anomalies to stop spawning. Prepare for a more dynamic and unpredictable adventure as you explore the unknown.

6. **Menu Mastery** Navigating the main menu is now a breeze. We've ironed out the kinks in the difficulty selection, ensuring a smooth start to your gameplay sessions.

7. **Resource Efficiency:** We've fine-tuned the game's resource usage across all levels, resulting in improved performance and faster loading times. Dive into the action without delay!

Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback. We're committed to creating a captivating and enjoyable gaming journey for you. We can't wait to see you in the ever-evolving world of our game. Until then, game on!

notes.title: Mac and Linux update

notes.title: Size reducing update 2.7
notes.notes:
[h1]Official Patch Notes - Update Spectator ver 2.7[/h1]

Greetings, Spectators! We are thrilled to announce the release of our latest update, Spectator ver 2.7. With this update, we have implemented several improvements and changes to enhance your gaming experience.

[list]
[*] Reduced Game Size:
We have reduced the size of the game by half! Now, depending on your platform, the game weighs just 3.4 GB. We were able to achieve this significant size reduction by optimizing our packaging technique.

[*] Updated Anomalies:
We have made improvements to the anomalies on levels Forest, Pizza, and Factory. With these updates, we aim to provide a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience for all our players.

[*] DLC Development Content:
We have extended the DLC development content by adding new screenshots for your viewing pleasure. 
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the latest updates and improvements to Spectator. As always, we welcome your feedback and suggestions. Thank you for playing and supporting our game!
[list]
[*] UPD hotfix -
 Fixed an issue where compression was too demanding for low-end PCs, causing performance problems.
[/list]
Important Notice:
Please note that due to the compression changes, some users may experience longer loading times.

notes.title: Release of Version 2.6.7
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce the release of Version 2.6.7! 

[list]
[*] Implemented a deterministic approach to the camera system on all level locations, resulting in a 50% faster switching between cameras on low-end computers and improved overall performance on all levels.
[*] This means that only 1/6 of the level is loaded per camera, reducing the system requirements and improving overall performance.
[*] Improved vegetation visuals on the Forest level to provide a more immersive experience.
[*] Optimized the Forest level, addressing possible crashes on low-end PCs.
[*] Implemented a fix for controller layout in Story mode on Windows systems, ensuring smooth gameplay.
[*] Improved controller recognition in Story mode by adding a notification if the game recognizes the controller.
[*] Improved monster's audio in Story mode, making it more immersive and engaging.
[/list]


We hope these changes enhance your gaming experience and make it even more enjoyable
